subject: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>; DevOps Lead <devops-lead@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Hi Priya and team,

Following our onboarding kickoff, we ran a quick internal pass on the private-deploy repo and want to align on pre-merge gates we expect before we hand over the GitLab MR for your environment. Attached is a concise checklist and the helm/ansible artifacts we referenced. High-level asks: 

- CI gating: unit lint + terraform plan drift check + helm values lint + ansible syntax check must pass on the MR pipeline.
- Network: the tf network-seg module should tag subnets for tenant isolation and expose an egress ACL; we flagged a minor CIDR overlap in our dry-run.
- Secrets: sops-encrypted values only; no plaintext KVs in repo (we'll provide keywrap guidance).
- Evidence: a build artifact link and an audit-run log for the preflight step.

Can you confirm what additional checks Acme requires (e.g., mandatory security scanner stage or a separate pre-deploy runbook for your on-prem ingress)? If agreeable, I'd like to schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to run through the MR and the gating jobs.

Attachments: priv-iac-safety-checklist.md, helm-values-acme.yaml, ansible-playbook-site.yml

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Lead <devops-lead@acmecloud.com>, CISO Office <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Thanks Mateo — this is helpful. Quick notes inline and questions attached: 

- CI gating: we require an extra stage that runs Trivy image scans (for any container images you build as part of the chart) and a lightweight policy check (conftest) against rendered manifests. Can Redwood add those stages or should we run them downstream in our pipeline?
- Network CIDR: we saw the dry-run overlap; our infra team prefers explicit /26 per tenant to make monitoring and eBPF rules simpler. Can you make the segment size configurable?
- Secrets: we use HashiCorp Vault with auto-rotate. Will sops keywrap integrate with your KMS guidance?

I've attached a short review doc with comments. If you can patch the tf module to expose segment_size and add a helm lint job with Trivy in CI, we can move to sign-off.

— Priya
Head of Platform, AcmeCloud
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>; Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Thanks Priya — fyi on the CI surface: 

- GitLab MR pipeline currently has stages: validate -> plan -> apply-preview -> helm-lint -> e2e-mock. We can add a trivy-scan stage after helm-lint and before apply-preview.
- Conftest policy: we have a policy repo; I'll open a small MR to reference the policy bundle so you can review the rules run.
- I opened MR! https://gitlab.redwood.com/acmecloud/priv-stack/merge_requests/342 (WIP) — the MR includes a job template trivy-scan:latest and a conftest include.

Action items for us: Karthik to propose tf change for segment_size, Mateo to add trivy job and document Vault/Sops integration pattern. Marissa, can you own the runbook for preflight evidence (artifact links + audit log extraction)?

Vanessa
Platform Ops Lead, Redwood
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Adding the tf patch here (attached as tf-network-seg-diff.patch). Summary of change: expose variable segment_size (default 26) and parameterize subnet naming to include tenant_id to avoid collisions. Also validated that adding a per-tenant egress ACL resource does not change plan on default single-tenant test (no drift).

Snippet: 
- variable "segment_size" { default = 26 }
- resource "aws_subnet" "tenant" { cidr_block = cidrsubnet(var.base_cidr, var.segment_size, var.tenant_index) 
  tags = { Name = "${var.env}-${var.tenant_id}-subnet" } }

I'll push the MR once Mateo confirms the CI trivy job name. 

Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Quick consolidation and next steps: 

- CI: I'll add trivy-scan:template to MR 342 and wire it into the pipeline after helm-lint. Job will pull images from the chart build step and run a single-stage scan; output will be saved as artifact in pipeline for your review.
- TF: Karthik's patch looks good — segment_size defaults to /26 and is exposed for your terraform workspace vars.
- Vault/Sops: Our recommended pattern is sops for repo-at-rest and a KMS-wrapped key that we can rotate; for Vault we'll add an example connector for dynamic secrets in the runbook.
- Evidence runbook: Marissa will publish preflight-evidence.md to the Drive folder and include a short audit extraction playbook (ansible-playbook-site.yml).

I've scheduled a 30-min sync for Fri 11/06 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent) to walk the MR and get sign-off. Please call out any blockers before then.

Attachments updated: priv-iac-safety-checklist.md (v2)

Thanks,
Mateo
From: Priya Ramesh <pri.ramesh@acmecloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Lead <devops-lead@acmecloud.com>, CISO Office <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: pre-merge IaC safety gates and automation sync

Thanks all — that's great progress. Confirming Acme can accept the following for sign-off: 

- trivy-scan job in MR artifacts + conftest policy pass on rendered manifests
- tf segment_size exposed and documented in workspace vars
- example Vault connector in runbook and confirmation that no plaintext secrets are in the MR

We'll join the 11:00 PT sync to validate the pipeline artifacts. If the artifacts show no high/critical findings and TF plan is clean for tenant /26 we will sign-off and merge.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
— Priya
